# viettelidc_ovpc_security_group_rules (Data Source)

List the inbound or outbound rules of a ViettelIDC Security Group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `direction` (String) Which rules to return: "in" (inbound) or "out" (outbound).
- `security_group_id` (String) Security Group whose rules to list.

### Optional

- `vpc_id` (String) VPC ID; falls back to the provider default vpc_id.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `destination_ip` (String)
- `direction` (String)
- `ether_type` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `port` (String)
- `protocol_name` (String)
- `rule_type` (String)
- `source_ip` (String)
- `status` (String)
